# Closed inputs and an independent method result

Authored fixture with private and package instance methods whose sole Object
formal occurs only in the result. Class and Set inputs contain complete closed
wildcard trees. The private method recurses, invokes a provider, writes state,
and retains its actual Object result across a later observer and checked cast.
The frozen caller and observer cover direct, reflection and method-handle
routes, discarded results, exact failures, partial stores and receiver identity.
